responsibility: Implements the collect2 post-driver linking helper that wraps the real linker, scans objects and libraries for constructor, destructor, frame, and export symbols, and synthesizes any extra inputs needed for runtime initialization support. It owns target- and format-specific collection logic such as COFF/XCOFF symbol scanning, AIX export-list handling, LTO mode coordination, invocation of nm/ld/strip and optional dsymutil, plus generation of the temporary constructor/destructor tables or related linker-side metadata that bridge compiled objects to final program or shared-library startup behavior.
same_name_distinction: This is the main executable implementation in the collect2 pair: it drives linker wrapping, symbol scanning, constructor/destructor collection, AIX export handling, LTO coordination, and post-link helper invocations. Unlike gcc/collect2.h, it contains the operational logic of collect2 rather than the shared declarations and state exports that support it.
